Hammer.js touch-input layer
Source: https://github.com/hammerjs/hammer.js/tree/v2.0.8
Downloaded file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hammerjs/hammer.js/v2.0.8/hammer.js
License: MIT; original license and headers retained in hammer-LICENSE.txt and source.
The upstream v2.0.8 tag file retains its v2.0.7 banner/version; it has not been rewritten.
No runtime CDN, no additional runtime dependency.
Only the normalized TouchInput events are consumed. Quiz actions, cancellation guards and finger-count rules are local code.
